title: Backlog: automatic intake and review aids
goal: Defects and drift that the pipeline, the query-log store, git history and the backlog already show reach the backlog as draft items without a person filing them, found by deterministic detectors and filed once per fingerprint.
notes: Intake uses no model: every detector is a rule over the store, git and item files. Its drafts stay uncommitted until /kb-backlog triage, so it adds no autonomous write path to main.
